top.title: Ukraine: Deadly Russian drone strike hits central Kyiv
top.summary: A Russian drone strike hit central Kyiv before 8am on 25 September, killing a 14-year-old and leaving rescue workers clearing rubble from damaged buildings. Residents said there was little time to react to the air raid sirens, as Russia's increasingly deadly drone attacks also struck logistics facilities and postal infrastructure elsewhere in the city. FRANCE 24's Gulliver Cragg has the details from Kyiv.

articles.title: Russian attacks on Kyiv kill 7, including 14-year-old boy, injure 59 as drone strikes continue into daytime
articles.summary: A Russian missile and drone attack set fires in Kyiv and damaged a commercial building overnight on Sept. 25, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said.
